@title GiwaPoolFactory
 @notice Core Factory contract for deploying Concentrated Liquidity (CLAMM) and Stableswap pools on Giwa Chain.

@title GiwaStableDeployer
 @notice Dedicated deployer contract for Stableswap Curve Invariant Pools

@title GiwaStablePool
 @notice Stableswap pool implementing the Curve-style invariant for ultra-low slippage swaps between pegged assets.

@title IGiwaCLPool
 @notice Interface for Giwa Concentrated Liquidity AMM Pools (CLAMM).

@title IGiwaCLDeployer
 @notice Deployer interface for Concentrated Liquidity Pools

@title IGiwaStableDeployer
 @notice Deployer interface for Stableswap Invariant Pools

@title IGiwaPoolFactory
 @notice Comprehensive Factory Interface for Giwa DEX deploying Concentrated Liquidity and Stableswap Pools.

@title IGiwaStablePool
 @notice Interface for Stableswap pools utilizing amplification coefficient (A) for ultra-low slippage pegged swaps.

@title IGiwaUniversalRouter
 @notice Single entry point for routing swaps across Concentrated Liquidity (CLAMM) and Stableswap pools.

@title IPermit2
 @notice Uniswap Permit2 interface for single-signature batch token approvals.

@title GiwaUniversalRouter
 @notice Universal Router for Giwa Chain aggregating swaps across Concentrated Liquidity and Stableswap pools with Multi-Hop SOR and Permit2.
